I came here many years ago after I incurred the hatred of the High Priests. Apparently I was trying to clarify the truth too specifically. Anyway, I much prefer the liberal atmosphere here over the corrupt i…

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30036-02.html.text: Priest Petron: I beg you! Please get rid of the malignant spirit Nahir coiling in the Elven Ruins . This will enhance your learning.

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30036-03.html.text: Priest Petron: Nahir... May his poor spirit rest in peace... Thank you. Now I will tell you Nahir's story. He was once a faithful follower of Einhasad. But while he was helping his friend who was a follower of Shilen, he incurred Einhasad's wrath and was turned into a monster. Until this day he roa…

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30036-04.html.text: Priest Petron: Your journey toward the truth has only just begun. You must visit Andellia of the Elven Village and hear what she knows about Eva. May Einhasad protect you on your way...

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30036-note.text: Priest Petron: I hope that your faith is consistent, just as the brilliance of Einhasad, Goddess of Light... Hello! Nice to meet you. ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30036.html.text: Priest Petron: May the splendor of Einhasad, the goddess of light, shine upon you. Welcome to the Temple of Einhasad. Serving the goddess is fulfillment itself. Trust in her and do her will and you will not regret it.

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
